title: Craftable Infested Blocks
description: Allows you to craft all infested block variants using a potion of infestation as well as the base block for each variant.
body:
Adds crafting recipes for all infested block variants in Minecraft, finally allowing you to obtain infested blocks in your survival inventory.
To craft an infested block type, place one potion of infestation in the middle of a crafting table, surrounded by 8 of the base block for the infested block you wish to craft. See screenshot for example.
